name: Progress stepper
purpose: Numbered nodes on a rule that fill as a process advances (recipe steps, setup stages, chapters), so the viewer always knows where they are and how much is left on a single persistent stage.

implementation.api: Studio.comp.stepper(parent, steps, {labels}) -> {enter(tl, at), advance(tl, index, at), exit(tl, at)}

layout_notes: Spans its parent's width with equal columns; the rule runs between the first and last node centres. With more than 5 steps in portrait, shorten labels or pass labels:false and name the step elsewhere.

validation.evidence: Runtime self-test (earlier nodes completed, rule filled to the current node) in Playwright Chromium on Windows, 2026-10-30.
